question: Who among the following is NOT a member of the historic four-person crew for the Artemis II mission scheduled for April 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Anne McClain.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **NASA has officially begun the countdown for the Artemis II mission, the first crewed journey to the Moon in over 50 years, scheduled to lift off on April 1, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Artemis II Crew consists of:**

 
 
• **Reid Wiseman (NASA):** Mission Commander.
 
• **Victor Glover (NASA):** Pilot and the first person of color on a lunar mission.
 
• **Christina Koch (NASA):** Mission Specialist and the first woman to travel beyond low-Earth orbit.
 
• **Jeremy Hansen (CSA):** Mission Specialist and the first non-American to journey to the Moon.
 
 
 
• **Mission Details:** The 10-day mission will use the **Space Launch System (SLS)** rocket and **Orion** spacecraft to perform a lunar flyby.
 
• **Launch Site:** Launch Complex 39B at **Kennedy Space Center**, Florida.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Artemis I:**__ An uncrewed flight test successfully completed in 2022 to pave the way for this crewed mission.
 
• __**Trajectory:**__ The spacecraft will follow a **free-return trajectory**, using lunar gravity to head back to Earth for a splashdown in the Pacific Ocean.
